text: A news sweep's strongest pair can be spent by a SIBLING vertical the day before: on 2026-11-18 the two best papers of the window (2611.19886 risky fallback + 2611.20595 SilentGuard) were already the anchors of ai_observability_qa's 2026-11-17 piece on the same front. Check published_log.md for the last 7 days across every vertical sharing this target_domain, and compare at the ANCHOR (arxiv id / report) level before scoring — a headline-level check misses a synthesis that used the paper under a different angle.

article_reviewer's rewrite reliably strips the inline internal link from the draft (the 2026-11-18 final carried 'durable execution leaves open' as plain text) and article_shape then hard-fails the push. Re-link the _final.md by hand — site-relative markdown [text](/path/), target probed 200 — and re-run the gate step (python3 scripts/run_pipeline.py gate --file <final>). Do not re-run the reviewer to fix it.

illustration_creator.py can refuse three art-director briefs in a row on the bare-geometry validator ('prompt names no a structural arrangement'), leaving the push hero-less (featured_media 0 — the third such ship in three runs). Re-commission with the treatment pinned via illustration_creator.py --apply --style <treatment> --model flux, which satisfies the validator's optic, light, texture and framing classes; pick a treatment absent from the last four sidecars. A hero set on featured_media still does not reach the static front until a draft→publish toggle fires the rebuild.

Supabase.record_push(row_id, metadata, record) REPLACES metadata.wordpress with its third argument — it does not merge. Passing the row (or {}) as that argument wipes the push bookkeeping (post_id, media_id, link, term ids, media_alt) and the database then disagrees with the CMS while the article stays live. To update one field, read the row's metadata.wordpress, edit that dict, and pass it back as the third argument; verify with an immediate read-back of metadata.wordpress before moving on.

The Loop 3 rewrite re-voices a sentence and silently drops the site-relative markdown link inside it while keeping its anchor text, so the accepted _final.md can carry zero inline internal links and article_shape hard-fails it — re-add the one earned link by hand on the _final.md before running gate; do not re-generate (the report shows hard=0, hard=0 means the rewrite was fine).
